title: Account for acquisition of property, plant, and equipment through debt and equity issuances

items.concept: Initial recognition of specialized equipment at cash + PV of noninterest-bearing note; effective-interest subsequent measurement schedule; period-end adjusting JEs for discount amortization; maturity settlement; equity-issuance alternative
Number-variant twin — cash + PV of noninterest note (asset FV unknown); effective-interest schedule; period-end adjusting JEs; maturity settlement; equity alternative

Period-end adjusting JE emphasis — note-year effective-interest schedule vs fiscal calendar allocation when acquisition is mid-year; maturity settlement; asset FV known / market rate unknown (impute rate)
Classification / method choice — more clearly evident measurement base for noninterest-bearing debt vs publicly traded equity
